newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Subscribe NatSteel Broadway - Fraser.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Subscribe NatSteel Broadway - Fraser.

text.p: Fraser Securities recommended on Thursday that investors subscribe to China-based NatSteel Broadway's Singapore initial share offering.

NatSteel Broadway, a manufacturer of plastic and metal components for electronics products, offered 33.8 million shares at US$0.70 each on September 26. Of the total, half have been placed out to institutions. Its initial share offer closes on October 8.

Fraser said the offer price was attractive at a prospective 1996 price earnings (PE) ratio of 9.2 times compared to other component makers Fu Yu Manufacturing and Amtek Engineering, both with a prospective PE of 15 times.
It said Natsteel's strength was its wide customer base, consisting mostly of multinationals.
"Increasingly, more MNCs are out-sourcing part of their manufacturing processes and this should benefit component manufacturers like Natsteel Broadway.

"In addition, by maintaining its close supplier-customer relationship with many of the MNCs, it is able to ensure a steady flow of business that grows in tandem with the growth of its customers," said Fraser.
Fraser said it projected over the next three years a compounded annual growth rate of 13 percent for the company's turnover and 14 percent for its net profit.
Natsteel Broadway recorded a net profit of Singapore $9.9 million on a turnover of S$88.2 million in 1995.
